name: Axi Sports Management App
summary: Quasar and Vue 3 sports-management application skeleton with Pinia, Vue Router, Vue I18n, and a Capacitor Android wrapper; the backend directory is only a placeholder.

entrypoints.purpose: Root Quasar component that renders the active Vue Router view.
Create the SPA router and select hash, history, or memory navigation.
Declare boot modules, build behavior, i18n resources, lint checking, and Capacitor integration.
Generated Android wrapper configuration for the shared Quasar bundle.

runtimes: Android toolchain only for native Capacitor builds
services: No real backend service is currently defined

variables.name: VUE_ROUTER_MODE
variables.source: Quasar build environment; defaults to the configured hash mode.

variables.name: VUE_ROUTER_BASE
variables.source: Optional router base supplied by the Quasar build environment.

variables.name: PORT
variables.source: Optional SSR production-port override; the current primary surface is SPA mode.

provides: Capacitor Android wrapper for the same frontend bundle
consumes: Capacitor Android runtime when building the native wrapper

active: Maintain a parseable, evidence-backed root documentation suite.
Keep Quasar lint and build clean.
Define future i18n, visual regression, and native-shell hardening work.
knownFailures: The unit-test script is a placeholder and no unit-test framework is wired.
The backend directory has no real service contract.
The application currently ships only the en-US locale.

troubleshooting.symptom: pnpm dev starts but the expected page is not available on port 5173.
troubleshooting.diagnosis: Quasar uses its own emitted development URL and commonly defaults to port 9000.
troubleshooting.resolution: Read the URL printed by pnpm dev and use the manifest health command when it is 127.0.0.1:9000.

troubleshooting.symptom: The build fails after adding or renaming a locale.
troubleshooting.diagnosis: src/i18n/index.ts or the Quasar i18n resource include no longer matches the locale files.
troubleshooting.resolution: Register the locale only in src/i18n/index.ts, keep the i18n boot module enabled, and rerun pnpm build.

troubleshooting.symptom: A native Android build cannot start.
troubleshooting.diagnosis: The Capacitor wrapper requires a local Android SDK and toolchain beyond the web dependencies.
troubleshooting.resolution: Verify the web bundle first, then install the src-capacitor dependencies and use an Android-enabled environment.

evidence: Manifest v2 required-field and referenced-file check passed with 25 references present.
pnpm build completed successfully with Quasar 2.18.1; the only warning was stale Browserslist data.
